name: Troubled Teens
overview: Scripture offers comfort and assurance to troubled teens by emphasizing God's constant presence and unfailing support. Believers are encouraged to be strong and courageous, trusting fully in the Lord rather than their own understanding, because He will never fail or forsake them. Even in the darkest and most fearful moments, God’s guidance and protection bring peace and strength, drawing near to those with broken hearts and promising a hopeful future filled with His righteous help.
